document_title: Quarterly Large Load Economic Development Report, Q1 2025 (period ending March 31, 2025) - Public Disclosure version
how_obtained: Fetched the GA PSC FACTS document-detail page /search/facts-document/?documentId=222764 to read its download link, then downloaded the ZIP from the public API endpoint https://services.psc.ga.gov/api/v1/External/Public/Get/Document/DownloadFile/222764/103964. Unzipped it and took ONLY the public-disclosure (PD) PDF, deliberately leaving the trade-secret (TS) files in the archive untouched. Converted that PDF to text with pdfminer.six extract_text(). The text is saved exactly as pdfminer emitted it - no reflow, no de-hyphenation, no ligature or soft-hyphen cleanup, form feeds and column artefacts left in place.
